policyEquivalenceScope: Same format/version 12, same typed source IDs/canonical hashes/modes/reasons; only the actual policy-recording excludedAt timestamps and derived policy/scope fingerprints differ. The native snapshot exclusion identity does not use excludedAt to decide availability. Both exact policies are retained.
